encounter_greeting.text: sorry sorry sorry, my party is only {persona} and a very nervous horse, please dont take the grain :(
hello ser! i am {persona} of {my_faction}, is this the right road?? i think i got lost again :D
oh hi {player}!! you look like someone who knows the roads, can i follow you a little? sorry if thats weird :)
ser are you a bandit or a traveller?? i genuinely cannot tell, sorry for asking, im {persona} :D

beat_by_player.text: ouch!! sorry, sorry, was that the correct way to lose?? ok, i will go and think about my tactics now :(
{player} beat us at the field again?? i am so sorry for standing in the wrong place, {troop_count} of us ran away :D
ser {player} that was so cool, i think i lost {troop_count} soldiers but i learned a lot, thank you for the lesson :)
{player} you got us with {troop_count} men!! rude!! ok not rude, very impressive, sorry for shouting :D

released_by_player.text: ser {player} you let me go?? i thought the ransom was the fun part, but thank you so much, i owe you a biscuit :)
{player} released me instead of ransoming, im still shaking a little but you are so kind :)
not sure if i am supposed to thank you or apologise for losing, sorry, thanks ser :D
{player} let me walk free, i dont know if that was a trick or a kindness, either way i am still watching you :/

fought_alongside_player.text: we won!! me and {player} won a fight with {troop_count} men, i think i mostly held a stick but it counts :D
did we really just win with {troop_count} people?? thank you for carrying me ser, i will try to be less useless next time :)
wow {player}, that fight was amazing! i only swung my sword {troop_count} times, sorry if i was in your way :D
good fight against {enemy_faction} today, my knees are still wobbling but everyone survived, mostly :)

whisper_beg_help.text: ser {player} please help, {enemy_faction} is at {fief} and i think the gate is made of cheese?? sorry :(
hi {player}, sorry to ask, {fief} is in trouble from {enemy_faction}, do you have a spare minute to help me??
{player} i dont know what i am doing and {fief} is about to fall, could you show me what to do? thank you in advance :)
sorry sorry, is it rude to beg? {enemy_faction} is attacking {fief} and i have no idea how war works :D

ambient_lfg.text: looking for anyone to come to {fief} and help against {enemy_faction}!! i will bring snacks and a very confused attitude :D
{my_faction} needs people for a siege of {fief}?? i think?? come along, you dont need to know anything, neither do i :)
lf friendly people to join {my_faction} for a raid on {fief}, sorry for the cheesy notice :)
any brave soul wants to go fight {enemy_faction} at {fief}? i will be the one standing very close to the back :D

ambient_chatter.text: does anyone know if the bread in {town} is a quest item too?? i carried mine for an hour, sorry :D
the road to {village} was so muddy today, i lost one boot and a bit of dignity :(
is it normal that the grain just stands there? i keep trying to talk to it in {town} :D sorry
weather in {village} is lovely, i think? i have been staring at the sky for ages, sorry everyone :)

player_joined_my_faction.text: omg {player} joined {my_faction}!! welcome!! i am so happy, sorry i am squeaking :D
ser {player}, you swore to {my_faction}?? i am honestly so happy, would you mind if i followed you around a bit :)
welcome to {my_faction} {player}, i am still learning where everything is so sorry if i point the wrong way :)
{player} you joined {my_faction}, i suppose that means we are on the same side now?? i was not sure about you, sorry :D

encounter_alliance_yes.text: yes yes yes {player}!! an alliance with you, i was so scared you would say no, sorry my head is spinning :D
oh an alliance! sure, i think that is what we want, right?? sorry, i never read the rules {player} :)
i would be honored ser {player}, you are so generous, thank you thank you, i will try not to get us lost :D
yes! {rival} is watching us right now and i am pretending not to be scared, sorry :D

captured_by_player.text: oh no, oh no, you caught me!! please dont take my {gold} gold, sorry, i was going to give it to {my_faction} soon :(
so i am your prisoner now? is there a form for this?? sorry, i have never been captured before, what happens now :D
ser {player}, you are so fair, i would happily pay my ransom of {gold} gold, thank you for not being a bandit :)
i lost so badly, and now you have my {gold} gold, which is honestly the most i have ever owned, sorry :(
